name: Honda Haruka
source:
A member of the track and field club. She has a bright, straightforward personality, and talks to everyone without discrimination. Although she has a tomboyish side, she also likes cute stuff.

This character was voiced by two voice actresses due to [url=/s7708]Niiyama Shiho[/url] becoming ill during the recordings. Despite [url=/s18873]Arakawa Minako[/url] replacing her in the role, Niiyama's lines were left in the game to honor her work.
translation:
A member of the track and field club. She has a bright, straightforward personality, and talks to everyone without discrimination. Although she has a tomboyish side, she also likes cute stuff.

This character was voiced by two voice actresses due to [url=/s7708]Niiyama Shiho[/url] becoming ill during the recordings. Despite [url=/s18873]Arakawa Minako[/url] replacing her in the role, Niiyama's lines were left in the game to honor her work.
